current.text: He missed all of last season with a torn ACL.
He has said he does not feel like himself, and his media day comments about his knee were troubling.
He is expected to be ready for opening night. If he has a setback, Marcus Smart would start in his place.
He is projected to start at point guard with Amen Thompson, Kevin Durant, Jabari Smith Jr. and Alperen Sengun.
The Rockets are expected to be cautious with his minutes. Lloyd projects about 32 minutes, starting near 30 and rising to about 34, and another expert says he could reach 35 by the end of the year.
Experts expect him to sit some back-to-backs, mostly early in the season, and to have days off.
Josh expects missed games and bad shooting stretches after the ACL injury.
The Houston guard rotation is crowded with Amen Thompson, Marcus Smart, Bogdan Bogdanovic and Reed Sheppard.
With many other ball handlers on the team, Lloyd is not banking on high assists from him.
Lloyd ranks him 120 to 135 in category leagues and sees him as a late point guard flyer.
Experts agree his ESPN rank of 74 is far too high and that he goes too early in mock drafts. Do not draft him at that price.
With a March 28 end, the Rockets have a weak 3-3-4 fantasy playoff schedule, 10 games over weeks 19 to 21.
The Rockets have only 14 back-to-backs this season.
The Rockets are predicted to win 54 games and to be conservative in the regular season.

durable.text: He is a very poor shooter from the field, especially on twos. His FG% clearly hurts a team.
He is a good three-point shooter.
He gives good steals and assists with fairly low scoring.
He takes good care of the ball and keeps his turnovers low.
He tore his ACL at an advanced age.

note: He is a late pick for us, not a core piece. Lloyd ranks him 120 to 135, which is bench territory in a 144-player draft and fits the Yahoo price (1 USD, rank 150) and our league's 1 USD last auction, not ESPN's rank 74. He fits punt FG% builds best, where his threes, assists, steals, FT% and low turnovers count and his 39% shooting does not hurt. Early in the season, check his minutes (about 30 is expected), whether he sits back-to-backs, and how his knee holds up. Also note the weak 10-game playoff schedule.
